paper_title: An Optimal Lower Bound for Smooth Convex Functions
summary: Two exact admissible quadratic trajectories establish IGMM loop nontermination and false OGMM ESP certification; a separate LRSP objective/gradient mismatch is locally established. Checked lower-bound construction not refuted.

problems.title: Fixed previous-step backtracking can loop forever

source_claim.location: Algorithm 3.1 p.12 line 21; arbitrary-quality solver p.11; rate (3.7) p.13
source_claim.paraphrase: Backtracking plus fallback produces IGMM iterates even for arbitrary-quality feasible QP approximations.

assumptions.history: genuine current and previous oracle records only

problems.check: First a1=4/5 accepted, x1=1/5. Next a=32/25 rejected. Update produces 16/25 forever; f_trial=121/1250 > -31/50 while a>=1/2. Repeated-state argument proves nontermination.
problems.result: Algorithm 3.1 as printed need not produce x2.
problems.counterevidence: An exact solve could avoid this example, but exactness is not required for IGMM. The narrower experimental subsolver does not replace the general algorithm contract. x1 is not an optimum.
problems.impact: Defeats progress of a proposed algorithm and application of the stated all-k rate; does not refute conditional Proposition 3.1 or the interpolation bound.

correction.verification: Analytic geometric decay guarantees fallback in finitely many rejections for ru>1.
correction.scope: Termination of this loop, not entire software certification.

problems.title: Missing tau term permits false normalized ESP

source_claim.location: (4.30) p.17; Algorithm 4.2 p.19 line5; Proposition4.2 pp.18-20
source_claim.paraphrase: The Newton validity test preserves the estimate-sequence certificate.

assumptions.QP: exact optimizer, hence nonworsening relative to prescribed starting point

problems.check: Second iteration has G=(1,1/2), H=(-1/4,-1/16), S=(3/4,7/16), e=1/16. Exact QP optimizer lambda=(0,1) at Abar=(3+sqrt(5))/4 and A=3. Printed Newton update returns A=3. Printed omega*=1/16 but exact omega*=0.
problems.result: The accepted value violates e<=min omega.
problems.counterevidence: Read routine e as input ebar. No rounding or approximate-QP explanation. A cannot consistently mean A+tau elsewhere. The example is not a violation of the function-error rate: f(x2)=1/32.
problems.impact: Invalidates the certificate propagation used for adaptive OGMM convergence, a core algorithmic guarantee.

correction.statement: Use S.lambda - (A+tau)/2 lambda^T Q lambda in the test.
correction.verification: Exact minimization identity for every feasible lambda; example yields corrected A=5/2.
correction.scope: Local certificate correction. Algorithm4.1 weight recurrence and zero denominator boundary still require reconciliation for whole-algorithm repair.

problems.title: Printed LRSP objective and gradient differ
assumptions: Real arguments; fixed matrix and labels; no A^T1=0 assumption.
problems.check: d/dz log(1+exp(-z))=logistic(z)-1, so actual gradient is A^T(logistic(Ax)-1-y).
problems.result: Printed minus actual gradient equals A^T1.
problems.counterevidence: They coincide for A^T1=0; that is not the stated Gaussian-design restriction. A sign typo in the objective is a plausible explanation.
problems.impact: Demonstrated experimental-oracle specification inconsistency; actual table generation and numerical damage unresolved.

correction.statement: Changing softplus to log(1+exp(z)) agrees with printed gradient; alternatively change gradient to differentiate literal objective.
correction.verification: Analytic chain rule and exact symbolic identity.
correction.scope: Historical implementation and reruns not verified.

additional_scope_points.observation: Printed sqrt(1+4LAk) differs from sqrt(1+8LAk) required for equality weight sequence; conservative step alone does not establish the advertised equality constant.
additional_scope_points.status: Repair-scope limitation; no additional claimed function-error counterexample.
